facts.fact: Le Brief reports the ANSS annual report as saying that the Direct Social Aid programme supports 3.9 million households at end-December 2025 and that its management information systems, run transitionally by CNSS and CNRA, are being migrated as-is to the ANSS with full switchover aimed for 2026.
